description: Defines the interface for a network socket class, including methods for reading, writing, and configuring socket options, as well as handling DNS aliases.

classes.name: net::Socket
classes.description: Abstract class representing a read/write network socket with methods for data transfer and configuration.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into a buffer asynchronously.

methods.name: ReadMultiplePackets
methods.description: Reads multiple packets into a results structure (STARBOARD-specific).

methods.name: ReadIfReady
methods.description: Attempts to read data without blocking.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket asynchronously.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the socket's receive buffer size.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the socket's send buffer size.

methods.name: SetDnsAliases
methods.description: Sets DNS aliases for socket reuse.

methods.name: GetDnsAliases
methods.description: Retrieves DNS aliases for the socket.
